cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1923; Private collection, Buffalo, New York, gift, 1970; (Linda Hyman Fine Arts, New York, NY); (Richard York Gallery, New York, NY); (Janet Gordon, ARRT Group, Carmel, California) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "On backing: by O'Keeffe: 'Georgia O'Keeffe –– 1919' [not verified] Note: Jan 1946 from Mrs. Dewald: One of the first Flower pieces. . . . Bought by Jacob Dewald." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates "gallery photo" [presumably from 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition; not verified]. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: An orange canna flower with red-tipped petals and a dark purple stem and leaves rises through the composition. The flower contrasts with a textured, greenish blue background that resembles layers of sea foam.
title: Canna
